record.text: Well, 76ers are 2-0 and the wins came against the 2026 Eastern Conference Finalists and both were after the Knicks and Cavaliers had double digit leads

#Cavs lose opening night to the 76ers 114-106. 

The Cavaliers led by as much as 29 points, but their own mistakes, turnovers and fouls undid it. A game that was eerily reminiscent of Game 1 of the ECF against the Knicks got things started for Cleveland. Yikes.

record.text: Good news for the Cleveland Cavaliers, they're 1-0 analytically. #NBA

FINAL: The Philadelphia 76ers complete a 29-point comeback and defeat the Cleveland Cavaliers 114-106.

From boos around halftime to elation in South Philly. Maxey was outstanding, LeBron had a much bigger impact in second half and Jaylen Brown was the finisher.
My favorite team, the Philadelphia 76ers, beat the Cleveland Cavaliers tonight and I think that’s lovely. The Sixers are 2-0.
Nice to see the Cavaliers already in midseason form.

Final:
Cavaliers 106
76ers 114

The Sixers have won, erasing a 29-point deficit and outscoring the Cleveland Cavaliers 69-37 in what has to be one of the best halves in franchise history. And they did it in front of an unbelievable crowd. Story to come!
Cavaliers reenacting conference final Game 1 collapse against the Knicks is certainly one way to open a new season.

What an inexcusable half of basketball from the Cavaliers. Utter garbage.
#Cavs #LetEmKnow

After the Cavaliers turn it over, the Sixers get a layup from Jaylen Brown, putting them up 8-0 with 44 seconds remaining. 

Generational fumble.

Cavaliers, you are rotting from the inside out, there is a sickness in your heart, and your leaders would not be fit to light the way in a rec league. Pathetic, tiresome team.

Sirens, please, as soon as you can
